intended_object: A `Fintype` structure on the set of values taken by the rank function `p₁.finrank` of a finite, flat, locally finitely presented morphism with quasi-compact target. It is built from the finiteness lemma `finite_range_finrank`. The docstring and the body show this.
explanation: This is a technical device, not a mathematical object. The body is just `Set.Finite.fintype` applied to the proof that the range of the rank function is finite. It turns the mathematical fact "only finitely many ranks occur when the target is compact" into the data Lean needs (a `Fintype` instance) so it can index finite sums or products over the occurring ranks. It adds no mathematical content beyond that finiteness lemma, so there is no separate object to compare it with.
